summary: Wrote full HANDOFF.md (~11KB): project state, 2-model design (similarity+perplexity), page list, auth choice, repo file structure, DB schema, and free-tier deployment plan for the DSA portal.

Scaffolded empty repo structure (40 files: frontend React pages/components, backend FastAPI app/routers/services, scripts, config); wrote ISSUES.md (22 detailed GitHub issues, one per file/feature, with acceptance criteria) and FILE_WORKING_GUIDE.md (build order + per-file implementation guidance for other agents).

Swapped perplexity model from codegen-350M-multi to PolyCoder-160M (confirmed DSA is C/C++ only; PolyCoder trained on C/C++ among 12 langs, smaller at 160M). Updated HANDOFF.md, ISSUES.md (#9, #22, added #23 resource-setup checklist), FILE_WORKING_GUIDE.md accordingly. Added RESOURCES.md listing all 5 free accounts/services and both free models needed, with the RAM-split rationale (HF Space hosts PolyCoder, not the Render backend).

Ran capacity math for 150 students (storage/compute) confirming no sharding needed on free tiers; wrote POLYCODER_GUIDE.md with full step-by-step reference implementation (load model, line perplexity, file stats, z-scoring, HF Space endpoint, backend HTTP call) and a C/C++ tokenization note; updated HANDOFF.md decisions.

Fixed auth.py to use Supabase's JWKS endpoint (PyJWKClient) instead of a static legacy JWT secret - new Supabase projects (sb_publishable_ key format confirms this project is on the new key system) often don't expose the legacy secret at all. Filled real Supabase URL/publishable key into frontend/.env, backend/.env (DB password + secret key + HF_SPACE_ID still pending). Rewrote .gitignore (was only ignoring one path - now covers .env, node_modules, __pycache__, venv). Created hf-space/ (app.py, requirements.txt, README.md) for the team's existing Gradio-SDK HF Space, using gradio_client calling convention. Updated POLYCODER_GUIDE.md Steps 6-7 and ISSUES.md #22/#23 to match. Cleaned stray duplicate files again.
